label: NUP98::HOXD13

sections.text: NUP98 encodes a nuclear pore protein with an amino-terminal region involved in transport and transcriptional regulation.
HOXD13 encodes a homeobox transcription factor involved in limb patterning.

The fusion retains the amino-terminal FG-repeat region of NUP98 and creates an abnormal transcriptional regulator associated with sustained HOX-gene expression. The HOXD13 homeodomain supplies DNA binding to the NUP98 activation region.
